description.value: A two-day fMRI study of immediate and approximately 24-hour prolonged effects of cognitive reappraisal and distraction on emotional experience and neural activation in healthy women.

value: An immediate reduction of negative feelings was expected for both, distraction as well as down-regulation of negative emotions by cognitive reappraisal, whereas up-regulation was expected to augment negative feelings.
